finalText:
The build passes now — link stage completes and exits clean (0 errors).

Two real bugs were hiding in the deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing how it hands off config:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That was throwing on `undefined.toFixed()` and aborting the build outright.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid and threw. The old loader used to send `false` for "off"; the new one just leaves it `undefined`. Fixed it to treat `undefined` the same as `false`.

Retry budget now resolves to 3 and backoff correctly reports disabled. The 8 remaining `WARN DEP0*` lines are genuine deprecation noise from the dependency bump itself, not bugs — build finishes in 44.9s with 0 errors.
